  • Constructor Details

    • DiceEncounterBehaviour

      public DiceEncounterBehaviour(Random random, CardService cardService)
      Creates Dice behaviour using the same eligible-card rule as the Wishing Fountain Event.

      Eligible IDs come from all registered card definitions, with null definitions and blank IDs ignored. IDs are deduplicated and sorted before deterministic random selection.

      Parameters:
      random - injected source used for dice and card selection
      cardService - authoritative source of registered card definitions
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the Card Service has no eligible card definitions
